description:
Protects the project's ACTIONS (the Object Template lists: WEB Click / Enter Text / … plus custom methods) against a bad "Sync Actions" run, which SimplifyQA applies server-side and can replace a template's list.
- action:"save" — writes a JSON snapshot of every action (name, display name, uniqueId, template, parameters) and reports the count per template. Do this BEFORE an AI/agent sync.
- action:"verify" — compares a snapshot with the live catalogue and lists the actions missing per template. Read-only.
- action:"restore" — re-CREATES the missing actions from the snapshot (never deletes or edits). Dry-run by default; pass `confirm:true` to write.
`snapshotPath` is returned by save and accepted by verify/restore (default: the newest snapshot of this project).

confirm.description: restore: true to actually re-create the missing actions.

snapshotPath.description: verify / restore: the JSON file written by save. Default: newest for this project.

name: action_template_backup
title: Back up / verify / restore the Action catalogue (Object Templates)
